training.method: joint observed response phases by request size and actual in-flight count; integer empirical mass; bulk buckets plus each sparse upper-tail observation; transfer cost scales with requested bytes
training.weighting: one observation per completed real GET; no query runtime targets
training.scope: request-derived opt-in model; matching marginal phases does not establish benchmark accuracy
limitations: SDK timing includes client work and internal retries
conditional transfer costs approximate shared bandwidth; no hard concurrency cap established
loopback HTTP and timers add overhead; held-out benchmark validation required
